provenance: Transcribed from this task's postflight PowerShell tool output after the one smoke invocation; no separate contemporaneous file receipt was written by that shell command. This is not an independently replayed hash audit.

source_hash_comparison.method: For each of the 15 source_hashes in g3_qualification_gate.json, Get-FileHash SHA256 was compared with the gate entry; the shell would throw on any mismatch.

process_check: A separate Get-CimInstance Win32_Process check returned no solver/build/preparation child process. The only match was the PowerShell check process itself.
limitations: The original shell output is retained in the task transcript, not as an independently timestamped raw file; this JSON preserves the observed values and disclosure without rehashing or rerunning.
